entries.text: Oh man, I can tell just looking at you! You did it,\nright? You became a Champion?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_02

entries.text: Ha, you’ve got jokes! But seriously—you did\nbecome a Champion, right?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_01

entries.text: C’mon, it’s me! You don’t have to lie! Just tell\nme—you became a Champion, right?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_02

entries.text: OK, wait! You DID become a Champion, though,\ndidn’t you?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_03

entries.text: You! Champion! Yes?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_04

entries.text: Ha haaa! I knew all along![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_03

entries.text: I got word from La Primera when you cleared the\nElite Test![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh man, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
I’m a
Champion,
and
now,
you’re
a Champion![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_05

entries.text: Which means we’re true equals! You and me,\nboth Champion-ranked Trainers! This is amazing![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_06

entries.text: Now that you’ve made it here, I’ve got one thing\nto say.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_07

entries.text: Let’s you and me be best rivals for life![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_08

entries.text: Oops! Couldn’t hear you! I’ll say it again: let’s\nyou and me be best rivals for life![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_05

entries.text: Sorry, not going to stop until I hear a yes—\nlet’s you and me be best rivals for life![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_06

entries.text: OK, wait! You WILL be my rival, won’t you?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_07

entries.text: You! Me! Rivals! Yes?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_no_08

entries.text: YESSS! Toma ya![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_09

entries.text: All right! You know what rivals do? Battle their\nabsolute hearts out![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_10

entries.text: I’m gonna hit you with EVERYTHING this time!\nYou ready?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_11

entries.text: Do wait a moment, Champion Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_01

entries.text: Huh? What’s the matter, Primera?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_12

entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_02b

entries.text: Champions must be understanding toward\ntheir opponents.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_03

entries.text: Urk. Right...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_13

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]There I go getting overexcited again! Sorry,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
and
[VAR 0x0101(0001)].[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_14

entries.text: I also must ask—is this roadside really the setting\nyou two want for your first battle as true equals\r\nand rivals?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_04

entries.text: Hmm... Now that you mention it, that’s a\ngood point.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_15

entries.text: In that case, can we use one of the Pokémon\nLeague battle courts?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_16

entries.text: Surely there’s somewhere more fitting. A place\nwith special meaning for the two of you, perhaps.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_05

entries.text: Special meaning, huh? Hmm... Let me see...\nAnywhere leap to mind, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_17

entries.text: Out behind your house
entries.label: champ_0270_select_a

entries.text: Mesagoza
entries.label: champ_0270_select_b

entries.text: The Treasure Eatery
entries.label: champ_0270_select_c

entries.text: Haha! Our beach out back, huh? Yeah, the place\nwhere we had our first battle might work.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_answer_a01

entries.text: But on the other hand, to me it’s just kind of...\nmy backyard, y’know? A little ordinary.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_answer_a02

entries.text: Anyplace else come to mind?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_answer_a03

entries.text: The Treasure Eatery? Is it significant to the two of\nyou somehow?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_answer_c01

entries.text: Ah, are you thinking of it ’cause it’s got the\nMedali Gym’s battle court?\c\nI guess it does bring back memories...of Larry...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_answer_c02

entries.text: Larry may not appreciate the surprise visit.\c\nIf you’ve any other suitable places in mind, would\nyou prioritize them instead, please?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_answer_c03

entries.text: Mesagoza? Oooh, good call! The place where we\nset out on our journey![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_18

entries.text:
That reminds me, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
Remember back when Director Clavell explained
the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Treasure Hunt[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]? Y’know how he told us to go
in search of our own treasure?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_19

entries.text: Well, I know what treasure I got out of all this:\nI found a true rival—someone who can stand up\r\nto me at my full capabilities.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_20

entries.text: That’s right—I mean you! I’m so glad I got to\nmeet you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_21

entries.text: Anyway, that being said...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_22

entries.text: I’ll be waiting for you at the battle court in\nMesagoza’s central plaza! See ya there![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0270_rival_23

entries.text: The respect you two share is palpable. Even a bit\nenviable, to be honest.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_06

entries.text: I am known as La Primera—but even when facing\nme in the final test of her Champion Assessment,\r\nChampion Nemona didn’t reveal her full might.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_07

entries.text: In you, I suspect she has found someone she can\nbattle without holding anything back.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0270_chairman_08
